APP
- tactic.gotcha-prd.v1: Every app PRD should define the five-second gotcha moment that makes the product promise immediately understandable. — https://x.com/GeorgeLampro20/status/2081979523873038368

- tactic.feed-engineering-creators.v1: Use a dedicated research identity that behaves like the target customer so platform recommendations surface relevant creators. — https://x.com/GeorgeLampro20/status/2081979523873038368
- tactic.paid-promo-outreach.v1: Test concise creator outreach beginning with Paid promo? and a bounded daily send cap. — https://x.com/GeorgeLampro20/status/2081979523873038368
- tactic.annual-only-trial.v1: Test a three-day free trial only on the annual subscription package. — https://x.com/GeorgeLampro20/status/2081979523873038368
- tactic.gotcha-before-paywall.v1: Let onboarding execute the gotcha, then place the result reveal at the paywall. — https://x.com/GeorgeLampro20/status/2081979523873038368
- tactic.ad-mechanism-replication.v1: Use high-running competitor ads to form original replication hypotheses about hook, proof, pacing, offer, and CTA. — https://x.com/GeorgeLampro20/status/2081979523873038368
- tactic.parallel-build-ugc.v1: Run product construction and a high-volume UGC exploration lane in parallel. — https://x.com/ErnestoSOFTWARE/status/2082527284301300023
